sources.snippet: Qwen3-1.7B-Base Qwen3-1.7B-Base is a 1.7 billion parameter causal language model from Alibaba's Qwen team, released in July 2025. It is a base (pretrained) model trained on 36 trillion tokens across 119 languages, featuring a 32k token context window and designed for inference efficiency on resource-constrained setups.

sources.title: Qwen3-1.7B-Base: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: A: Qwen3-1.7B-Base covers 119 languages compared to Qwen2.5's 39 languages. It also incorporates improved training techniques (qk layernorm, global-batch load balancing) and a three-stage training pipeline designed to improve reasoning and long-context understanding, which should benefit multilingual tasks beyond simple language coverage.
